paragraphs.text: Doctors say that teenagers need at least eight ____ (hour) of sleep every night. However, a recent survey ____ (show) that most high school students sleep less than seven hours. Many of them stay up late playing games or ____ (chat) with friends online. Lack of sleep makes ____ hard for students to focus in class, and it can also make them feel sad or angry easily. Scientists have found that the more tired you are, the ____ (little) you remember the next day. So what should we do? First, go to bed at the same time every night, ____ on weekends. Second, put your phone away at least an hour ____ you go to bed, because the bright screen keeps your brain awake. Third, a short nap at noon ____ (be) helpful, but keep it under thirty minutes, or you may feel sleepier in the afternoon. Remember, good sleep is just ____ important as good food and exercise. Start tonight, and in a week you ____ (find) yourself full of energy.
